title: Archive through January 3, 2005 - Anonymous (Friday, November 5, 2004 - 07:06 pm)
content: I was dreaming. Then, suddenly, I was pulled into a tunnel - I was moving tremendously fast. I knew it was not just a dream anymore - I remember thinking - "I'm dying, I'm dying!” I moved through the tunnel, and there was wonderful music all around - similar to Enya, Clannad, that sort of sound. But even more beautiful. I had a feeling of complete calm, safety and joy - a kind of joy which is not physical, but spiritual. Words can't describe it, anyway. I was pulled through the tunnel, and there was an area in the middle of it, where there was a kind of status quo - where forces pulled both ways - back, or further into the tunnel. At this point, I saw a tremendous light at the end of the tunnel - some kind of being was standing there. An angel? Christ? I don't know. This being can best be described like a polished saxophone, with light pouring out from all the buttons. These "buttons" were points or light sources coming out from the "being.” Then, I heard a voice, yelling, slightly distressed - a woman's voice - "Not yet, not yet!” She said this in Norwegian ("Ikke ennå, ikke ennå!"). I was pulled back, with the same great speed as before, and was out of the tunnel. Then I woke up. I knew I had been out of this world. I remember asking: "Can I tell about this experience?.” I felt that the answer was: "Yes.” I told my mother and sister about it the next morning - but my mother, maybe a little concerned about the seriousness of the thing, dismissed it. She told me that I had been dreaming of getting a saxophone when I was 16 years old (I had), and that this explained why I saw saxophone-like things. I didn't push it - I felt they wouldn't understand. I knew what I had experienced, that was enough for me! I've never had any "dream" like this later - only this one time. It was not a dream - it was real.

arrival.other_being_detail: A being at the end of the tunnel described as "like a polished saxophone, with light pouring out from all the buttons" (points/light sources).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Music heard during tunnel passage; a "status quo" area in the tunnel where forces pulled both ways; heard a distressed woman's voice saying (in Norwegian) "Not yet, not yet!"

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The being at the end of the tunnel was described as resembling a "polished saxophone" with multiple light points/buttons; music throughout the tunnel similar to Enya/Clannad; a mid-tunnel equilibrium area with forces pulling both ways.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I'm dying, I'm dying!"; "Not yet, not yet!" ("Ikke ennå, ikke ennå!"); "It was not a dream - it was real."
